demos.name: Agent Preferences Lab
demos.description: The user sets what their AI agent may do — allowed action tiers, a spend cap, what happens when Protect detects an AI agent — enforced at a mock MCP tool boundary: permit, human approval (HITL) or deny. Standalone mock of the AI-DEMO2 agentPreferences feature. Mock only.
demos.notes: Host-run: ./scripts/run.sh (port 7660). Mock only: no tenant, no credentials. Docker: HOST_PORT=7660 docker compose up --build -d (published on 127.0.0.1 only). Brand it with customer.config.json. The decision contract mirrors AI-DEMO2 PR #3401, enforced live 2026-11-06; per-call Protect evaluation is an open question. Catalog id pending owner assignment.
